career_ladder.note: Supply Inspector (Poorti Nirikshak) functions as the key regulatory and field enforcement officer under the Food and Civil Supplies Department (Khadya Evam Rasad Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh. Officers inspect fair price shops (FPS), enforce the National Food Security Act (NFSA), monitor essential commodity buffer stocks, and supervise the Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS).

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted through preliminary shortlisting using UPSSSC PET normalized scores, followed by a competitive Main Written Examination of 100 marks. Negative marking is 0.25 (1/4th) per wrong answer. Group C interviews were abolished by the Uttar Pradesh Government, making selection strictly merit-based on the written examination.

papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1/4 negative marking)

financial_package.note: Supply Inspector is remunerated at Pay Level 6 (Pay Band ₹9,300–₹34,800 with Grade Pay ₹4,200) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UP Food & Civil Supplies Department & UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 6
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 6 entry basic pay of ₹35,400 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹3,200 to ₹6,500 based on district/tehsil classification), PDS enforcement travel allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹5,593), professional tax, and group insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per UP Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized by posting city tier (Class X, Y, Z)
Traveling allowance (TA) and conveyance reimbursement for grain godown and FPS inspections
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
Official mobile allowance and leave travel concession (LTC)
